company.name: CareSwift
company.shortDescription: Careswift: Better Documentation, Fewer Denials, More Revenue
company.description: Careswift delivers AI-powered documentation solutions for EMS regulatory compliance. Our platform validates documentation against medical necessity criteria, reducing compliance risks while optimizing reimbursement. Agencies achieve improved claim acceptance rates, decreased denials, and faster payments while maintaining adherence to healthcare regulations and payer requirements. CareSwift combines technology innovation with revenue cycle optimization for emergency medical services reimbursement.
